item.title: Financial Navigators Program Impact
item.description:
Final Impact Report

Program Summary

In August 2020, the City of Columbus, in partnership with LSS 211 and the Legal Aid Society of Columbus, launched the Financial Navigator program as part of its rapid response effort to help residents manage the financial impact of COVID-19. Since then, Columbus Financial Navigators assisted over 2,100 individuals and families and helped residents identify immediate action steps to help manage expenses, maximize income, and access available resources. View the full Impact Report by clicking the link below.

Thank You to Our Partners

Columbus Financial Navigators connected those seeking help to those providing it in a challenging time and a rapidly changing social services landscape. We could not have done this without the incredible support of LSS 211 and the Legal Aid Society of Columbus, who agreed to provide or hire the incredible staff needed to operate this initiative. Here in Columbus, we served more residents than any other program in the nationwide pilot, and we wish to extend our sincere thanks to our partners for making that possible.

 -- The City of Columbus Financial Navigators Team

Impact Evaluation Survey

Because you completed a session with a Financial Navigator, we would like to get your feedback and offer you the chance to win a $100 Kroger eGift Card.
